crossRefs.note: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear…
Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for…
To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures…
Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
“For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are…
If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from…
Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the…
For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be…
Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and…
In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

translations.web: Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
translations.bsb: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
translations.kjv: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord
translations.asv: Wherefore be ye not foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
